bounds.proof_caps: the exact σ and Ω transport lengths of the frozen verifying-key allowlist, with Ω + the largest σ_send <= payment_proof_budget_bytes, σ_recv <= credited_receive_proof_budget_bytes and Ω <= lineage_proof_cap_bytes; every σ <= sigma_proof_cap_bytes and Ω <= omega_proof_cap_bytes; structural Payment admission enforces both role capacities independently of the joint budget

capsule_commitment.scope: Receive private-custody codec sample; proof bytes remain stand-ins

digest_rule: H(role, body) = SHA-256(prefix || role || 0x00 || LE64(len(body)) || body)

digests.object: relation bindings of the scheme (stand-ins and the computed allowlist digest)
NEW unadmitted DATA app policy; public pins are placeholders, no approval
NEW unadmitted DATA enrollment policy; public pins are placeholders, no approval
receiver App Attest enrollment assertion client data
App Attest renewal assertion client data

field_encodings.element_rule: 32-byte little-endian canonical encoding (< p); an integer, tag or mask is one element; a 32-byte SHA-256 digest or identifier is two u128 limbs, low half first; a Poseidon value (commitment, chain, root, nonce, credit_id, proof_digest, statement, object, certificate-set, package, operation, nullifier, Payment, lineage, credit-opening, credit-status or credited digest, signing message) is one element
field_encodings.indexed_leaf_rule: leaf = P(kgwimlf1, [key, value, next_key]) with value = P(value domain, elements); node = P(kgwimnd1, [left, right]); an empty slot is 0; depth 32, slot bit h selects the child at height h; the empty tree is the sentinel (0, 0, 0) in slot 0
field_encodings.packing_rule: P_bytes(domain, b) = P(domain, [len(b)] || c_0 || ... || c_(m-1)), m = ceil(len(b) / 31), c_i = bytes 31i..31i+30 of b as a little-endian integer, the last chunk zero-filled
field_encodings.poseidon_rule: P(domain, items) = iroha_pasta::poseidon::hash_with_domain::<Fp>(domain, items) (RP57): a fresh sponge absorbs [domain, len(items), items...]; domain is the u64 of the 8 little-endian ASCII bytes

norito_header.crc64_rule: CRC-64/XZ of the payload, stored little-endian; crc64_hex is big-endian

blacklist.order: limb order: int(a) = hi * 2^128 + lo, the 32 bytes read as one little-endian integer

large_input_digests.object: proof_digest of the Send: stand-in Ω(pred) and σ_send
proof_digest of the Receive: stand-in σ_recv
Payment digest over the payment transcript
lineage digest over the stand-in Ω(pred) bytes of the Payment
credit-opening digest of the CreditStatus opening
credit-status digest of the folded crediting head
Credited digest of the Receive form
Credited digest of the Status form

signing_messages.object: Receive receipt binding the Payment digest

signature_boundaries.derivation: m = P_bytes(domain, transcript); r = x(k*G) mod n; s = floor(n/2); e = SHA-256(m) mod n; d = (s*k - e) * r^-1 mod n; public key Q = d*G

signature_rule: ECDSA-P256-SHA256 over the 32-byte message_hex = P_bytes(domain, transcript_hex); RFC 6979 from the fixed scalars, frozen to low S; a consumer accepts iff codec_ok and verify_ok

signatures.object: Receive receipt binding the Payment digest

stand_ins.field_value_rule: seed s: 31 bytes s followed by s & 0x3f (little-endian, canonical)
stand_ins.lineage_proof_byte_rule: Ω transport proof byte i = (i + 7) mod 251; CreditStatus Ω(h): (i + 11) mod 251; every Ω has the allowlist's lineage_proof_bytes
stand_ins.note: labelled stand-in values: proof bytes, relation bindings, verifying keys and the lineage roots of the Payment's Ω(pred) are fixed by the G3 artifact set and lineage relation; vectors that depend on them change then. Map roots, credit-digest roots and openings are computed. The relation identity and the artifact manifest bind the computed digest of the vectored allowlist, and every stand-in σ and Ω has exactly its allowlisted length
stand_ins.verifying_key_rule: σ verifying-key digest: 32 bytes 0x80 | tag << 3 | mask; Ω transport key: 32 bytes 0xc4; σ length: 48 at the empty mask, 49 at the other mask of Send
